title: No ShopCoach, passing findings, unlisted parts and Deselect all
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. An organisation without ShopCoach; and a completed inspection with a mix of passing and flagged findings, open at the proposed-lines panel.
custom_steps:
1. Without ShopCoach, confirm this story does not apply and no build action exists.
2. Confirm a passing finding never becomes a proposed line, and no part is proposed that ShopCoach was not given.
3. Deselect every proposed line and confirm Add Lines is unavailable rather than silently adding nothing.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Without ShopCoach, this story does not apply and no build action exists.
  • A passing finding never becomes a proposed line.
  • No part is proposed that ShopCoach was not given.
  • Deselecting every proposed line leaves Add Lines unavailable rather than silently adding nothing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9404 (S15 — Draft the lines with ShopCoach); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S15; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S15-N1: “If the organisation does not have ShopCoach, this story does not apply and no build action exists (S2-R0)”
  • S15-N2: “A passing finding never becomes a proposed line”
  • S15-N3: “No part is proposed that ShopCoach was not given”
  • S15-N4: “Deselecting every proposed line leaves Add Lines unavailable rather than adding nothing silently”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
